field.label: Sequence
field.help: Central servers are tried in this order: when the first stops answering, the next one takes over.

field.label: Address
field.help: IPv4 address of the central RADIUS server.

field.label: Port
field.help: UDP port of the central RADIUS server, 11812 by default.

field.label: Secret
field.help: The RADIUS shared secret of this central server. It is never shown again; leave the field empty to keep the stored one.
